backlog.description: Continue auditing `jotd666` repositories not yet promoted, especially candidates with missing or template/copied READMEs; require project-specific evidence before adding them.
backlog.notes: Inventoried all 61 public JOTD repositories. Promoted Xevious and Galaxian after project-specific README verification, plus eight distinct Amiga tools, ROM, relocation and slave collections. Copied READMEs were checked against source: Rolling Thunder, Dig Dug, Mr. Do! and Bosconian have distinct Amiga assembly and are catalogued as work in progress, without build or playability claims. Gods Deluxe and Supercars 3 have project-specific remake documentation and were also promoted. The copied Berzerk listing credits Scott Tunstall; catalogued his canonical arcade disassembly and marked JOTD's copy as a duplicate. Tiger Heli and Super Pac-Man still contain mostly copied Amiga templates and need more subject-specific proof; Jungle King has an arcade-only listing, Marble Madness 2 an incomplete loader, and JRPacman500 an ambiguous asset script. Decisions and evidence URLs record these unresolved cases. Rechecked five residual JOTD repositories on 2026-09-25: Tiger Heli still includes Commando-specific Amiga source and a Jail Break README; Super Pac-Man includes Mappy-labelled slave/source and README; Jungle King has a Z80 arcade listing without an Amiga port; Marble Madness 2 explicitly still needs ROM patching and asset work; JRPacman500 contains only an asset-conversion script. Keep Amiga port claims deferred. Profile-wide inventory complete: all 61 public repositories have either a catalogue record or an explicit documented decision. The five residual Amiga port claims remain individually deferred until project-specific proof appears; closing the inventory task does not promote them.
